title: The sohba of the salihin is to bring the attenders to perfection
body:
The sohba of the salihin is to bring the attenders to perfection, kemal, everyone to his station. Only Allah has
absolute perfection. Shaitan always wants to divide people, Allah wants to unite them, but people don't follow
Him. Allah wants to join the hearts, but the Ummah doesn't listen to His Words and therefore Allah doesn't
help them… May Allah make us from those who understand and apply their knowledge.
